To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the isthmian organizer is the mes-met-encephalic organizer that is responsible for regionalization of the midbrain and hindbrain and that this organizer is defined by Fgf8 expression.
the isthmic organizer is required for mes-metencepahlon regionalization.
the dience- isthmus-mes-metencephalon organizer system is responsible for the formation of the mes- and metencephalic brain regions.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the molecular basis of brain development, especially the development of the mesencecephalon and metencecephalon.
the role of the isthmus as a signaling center in the developing brain.
the molecular mechanisms of the brain plan, especially the mechanisms of regionalization.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the isthmic organizer is a region where the expression of Fgf8 is regulated by the interaction of transcription factors.

the isthmocerebellar organizer is a signaling center, which is responsible for regionalization of the metencephalon and the mesencephalion, and the expression of Fgf8 is the key to this regionalization.

the isthmic organizer is a source of Fgf8, which induces the expression of Otx1/2 in the mesencephalons and Gbx2 in the metencephalon and that the Otx1/ Gbx2 expression domains define the mes-met boundary.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the mesencephalonic and metencephalic regions are defined by the repressive interaction of Otx2 and Pax6 with Gbx2 and En1 respectively and the isthmus organizer is induced by Fgf8.
the mes-met boundary is defined by the expression of Gbx2 and that the Fgf8 signal is induced in this boundary region.
the isthmic organizer is the source of a strong Fgf signal and the Fgf8 signal is required for regionalization of the metencephalon.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the brain plan is defined by the expression domains and interactions of transcription factors and signaling molecules, and that the isthmian organizer is the main source of Fgf8, which is essential for cerebellar development.
the brain is patterned by a series of organizers that are defined by overlapping transcription factor expression domains.
the brain is organized by a set of organizing signals, transcription factors and repressive interactions.
